layers.note: A many-stemmed columnar cactus to 7 m, in the open subcanopy.

heat_load.note: Warm south-facing slopes at its northern limit.

shade_tolerance.note: Establishes under nurse shrubs; adults in sun.

coldest_c.note: Frost-free or nearly so winters: coldest-month means from about 11 °C.

hard_freeze_c.note: Its northern limit is set by frost: lows below about −3 °C damage it, and it is gone where the year's coldest night falls below about −5.5 °C.

summer_rain.note: A summer-rain plant of Sonora and southern Arizona.

provenance.notes: Organ pipe cactus. A desert niche of plant forms F8's first placement (2026-10-07): authored from general knowledge of the species in the Sonoran Desert and checked against the Saguaro National Park places' CHELSA V2.1 climate (bajada 752 m, rocky hills 1,096 m), not yet against the public-domain FEIS reviews or fitted to occurrence records; the fit to GBIF occurrences over CHELSA comes with PlantGen (F8 in docs/roadmaps/PLANTS.md). Only the climate and site ranges niches have today: no soil, wash, spacing or nurse rules yet.
